title: {{NAME}} and the Sky Lab in Trouble
moral: Sharing what makes you special helps everyone.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a chrome silver superhero suit with a blue lightning bolt, a bright yellow cape, and sleek white rocket boots — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} flew up to a floating sky lab.
The lab was made of shiny silver panels.
Robots inside flashed warning lights.
A unicorn floated near the window.
Something had gone very wrong up there.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} flew through the lab door.
A big red robot met him inside.
"Our power crystal is cracked," it said.
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide with worry.
"I want to help fix it," he said firmly.

Its horn began to glow very bright.

{{NAME}} used his super energy to help.

{{NAME}} pushed harder.
He gave everything he had.
The crystal blazed with golden light!
All the warning lights turned green at once.

pages.content:
The sky lab hummed and glowed again.
The robots danced a funny robot dance.
The unicorn floated softly to {{NAME}}.
It rested its head on his shoulder.
{{NAME}} smiled and closed his eyes.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. You saved the lab today.
I wonder what stars the unicorn can show you from up here.
